data.one_liner: Generates documentation files from template files, importing other files or Dart documentation comments.
data.what_it_does: Generates various documentation files like README.md, LICENSE, CHANGELOG.md, and GitHub wiki pages from templates. It reuses and imports files or Dart documentation comments using a template engine.
use_when: You want to automate the generation of your project's documentation and markdown files from templates
You want to pull Dart documentation comments directly into your documentation files
avoid_when: You are looking to generate traditional API documentation (use dartdoc instead)
strengths: Simplifies keeping documentation up to date with code comments and other files
Integrates with build_runner for automated generation
Includes setup commands for easy project initialization
weaknesses: Not intended for generating API documentation
data.setup_notes: Can be set up using 'documentation_builder setup' or manually by adding build_runner and documentation_builder as dev dependencies and configuring build.yaml.
